options.text: \(f\) is continuous at only those points which are perfect squares.

solution.text:
Hint: \(\underset{\downarrow \atop \large \text{discontinuous}}{\left[x^2\right]} \sin \pi x\)
at all points where \(x^2\) is integer
If \(x^2\) is integer and \(x\) is also integer then \(f(x)\) will be continuous, but if \(x^2\) is integer and \(x\) is not integer then \(f(x)\) will be discontinuous.
